note: Sources added by the EMEA and East Asia facility batch, 17 September 2026. Every page listed here was fetched and read on that date, by WebFetch or by the browser tools where the site returned a shell or a 403. Where a figure appears in a record, it appears on one of these pages.

sources.title: Acıbadem Healthcare Group
sources.note: founded 1991 by Mehmet Ali Aydınlar; IHH Healthcare took a majority stake in 2011 and holds about 90 per cent after the 2018 share conversions; 29 hospitals and 15 medical centres; flagship Acıbadem Altunizade, Üsküdar, Istanbul

sources.title: About us — Acıbadem Healthcare Group, international site
sources.note: the group's own figures for international patients: 45+ hospitals and clinics, 7 JCI-accredited hospitals, 3,300+ specialist physicians, patients from 90+ countries, 55 international patient offices

sources.title: Check Up Paketleri ve Fiyatları 2026
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026. The page is titled check-up packages AND PRICES and lists the contents of each programme — examinations, radiology, laboratory and cardiology test counts — with a Fiyat Sor (ask the price) button in place of every figure. No amount is printed anywhere on it.

sources.title: Anadolu Medical Center
sources.note: opened 12 February 2005 by the Anadolu Foundation, affiliated with Johns Hopkins Medicine International; 209 beds plus 59 intensive care beds and 8 operating rooms; Gebze, Kocaeli

sources.title: JCI — Joint Commission International
sources.note: the hospital's own statement: JCI first granted 2007, seventh accreditation earned, three-year re-survey cycle. The same page names Planetree Gold, the Association of European Cancer Institutes, ESMO and the Türkiye international health tourism authorisation certificate.

sources.title: About Us — Memorial Hospitals Group
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026. The group's own counters: 92 medical units, 12 hospitals, 7,300+ employees, 1,510+ bed capacity, patients from 167 countries. Founder Turgut Aydın's message states the group took the JCI accreditation certificate first in Turkey and 21st in the world. The timeline page dates Memorial Şişli's opening, its heart centre, its transplant licence of March 2004 and the group's overseas offices.

sources.title: Şişli Hospital — Memorial
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026 for the address Piyalepaşa Bulvarı 34385, Şişli, Istanbul. The hospital page links health packages — cancer control and heart control programmes — under a contact form; no price appears on it.

sources.title: Check-Up Packages — Complete Health Screening Services
sources.note: fifteen screening packages priced in US dollars on the hospital's own international site and read there on 17 September 2026, each stated as a starting price per person and each listing its test counts by category. LIV STANDARD MEN from 600 USD and LIV STANDARD WOMEN from 590 USD are the entry tier; LIV GOLD CANCER SCREENING from 3,200 USD is the top. The page states the prices include medical reports.

sources.title: About Us — Medicana Health Group
sources.note: the group's own account: services begun 1992, 18 hospitals of which 16 across seven Turkish cities and two abroad at Winchester and Sarajevo, and more than 5.5 million patients a year. No bed count, no doctor count and no accreditation is named on the page.

sources.title: Medicana International Istanbul Hospital
sources.note: the flagship's own page: 30,000 square metres, eight operating theatres, 26 observation beds, 26-plus clinical services, an international patient centre with full-time English, Russian, Arabic, Kurdish and Somali interpreters, and an image of the Türkiye health tourism authorisation certificate. The inpatient bed figure is blank in the page's own text.

sources.title: Hospital CIMA
sources.note: opened 2000, owned by International Hospital Corporation, 103 beds, tertiary acute care, JCI accredited with no year given

sources.title: Hospital Angeles Tijuana
sources.note: opened 2005, Grupo Ángeles, Zona Río, eleven floors, 49 metres, 29,108 square metres, built 2002 to 2004, the first hospital in the city with a heliport. The article carries no bed count and no accreditation.

sources.title: Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein
sources.note: society founded 1955 by members of the São Paulo Jewish community, hospital inaugurated 28 July 1971, run by the Sociedade Beneficente Israelita Brasileira Albert Einstein as a private nonprofit that also treats SUS patients; first health institution outside the United States accredited by JCI, in 1999; Morumbi, São Paulo. No bed, staff or patient counts on the page.

sources.title: Sheba Medical Center
sources.note: founded 1948 as Israel's first military hospital, civilian from 1953 under Chaim Sheba, government-affiliated, Tel HaShomer in Ramat Gan on an 800-dunam campus; about 1,580 beds, about 1,700 physicians and 12,000 other healthcare workers; over 1,000,000 patient visits a year including 200,000 emergency visits; Global Patient Services treats patients from over 100 countries; Newsweek ranked it 8th in the world in 2025

sources.title: Hadassah Medical Center
sources.note: founded 1934, owned and largely funded by the Hadassah Women's Zionist Organization of America; two Jerusalem campuses, Mount Scopus opened 1939 and Ein Kerem established 1961; over 1,300 beds in total, 31 operating theatres, 9 intensive care units; teaching hospital of the Hebrew University; Newsweek 2025 placed it 242nd in the world

sources.title: Why KHCC
sources.note: the centre's own claim to be the first institution in the developing world accredited by JCI as a disease-specific cancer centre, and the sixth in the world. The page gives no year, no bed count and no patient numbers.

sources.title: Who We Are — American Hospital Dubai
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026. Established 1996, part of the Mohamed & Obaid Al Mulla Group; 254 beds, acute general medical and surgical, more than 40 specialties, all physicians American board certified or equivalent; states it is the first hospital in the Middle East awarded the JCI and that its laboratory was the first in the region's private sector accredited by the College of American Pathologists; inaugural member of the Mayo Clinic Care Network; seven satellite clinics. The page footer carries the licence number MOH#Z8IXYQHM-041025.

sources.title: Normal Delivery Package
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026. The package page prints a full inclusion and exclusion list with no headline figure, and prices the exclusions instead: epidural anaesthesia Dhs 3,770, twin surcharge Dhs 2,050, routine medications capped at Dhs 450 and consumables at Dhs 1,500, baby vaccines about Dhs 300, a relative staying overnight Dhs 193 a day. It states the self-pay patient pays the entire package price in advance at sign-up, that a switch from normal delivery to caesarean is charged at the caesarean price, and that NICU, resuscitation and circumcision fall outside.

sources.title: Charité — Universitätsmedizin Berlin
sources.note: founded 1710; joint medical faculty of the Free University of Berlin and the Humboldt University; about 3,000 beds over four campuses — Charité Mitte, Benjamin Franklin in Lichterfelde, Virchow-Klinikum in Wedding and Berlin-Buch; 18,217 employees including 5,242 academic staff and 307 professors; annual budget 2.3 billion euro; Newsweek's 2026 list places it in the top 250

sources.title: Charité International Patients — Charité Healthcare Services
sources.note: the wholly owned subsidiary that handles administration for patients living outside Germany. The page states what the office does and gives its telephone hours, Monday to Friday 10:00 to 14:00. It publishes no price, no tariff and no deposit schedule.

sources.title: Heidelberg University Hospital
sources.note: medical teaching at Heidelberg from 1388; an independent public-law institution with its own board, financially separate from the university; 1,991 beds as of 2020; over one million patients a year; Im Neuenheimer Feld; the heavy ion therapy centre and the National Center for Tumor Diseases; Newsweek 2026 placed it 12th in the world

sources.title: Finance — International Patients
sources.note: the hospital's own money page for patients from abroad. A cost estimate is written only after its specialists have read the submitted records; the whole estimated sum is transferred before treatment and the appointment is confirmed on receipt; actual costs are settled afterwards and a balance below the pre-payment is refunded by the same route it came. Payment by bank transfer, by cash at the Kopfklinik cashier, or by card. No schedule of amounts is published.

sources.title: Introduction — About Us
sources.note: the hospital's own counters: 2,446 beds, 11,377 average daily outpatients, 654,536 inpatients a year, 47,460 highly sophisticated surgeries a year; established June 1989; 88 Olympic-ro 43-gil, Songpa-gu, Seoul 05505. It also carries the Newsweek placing — 22nd in the world and first in Korea for seven consecutive years — and KMAC's most-respected-hospital run.

sources.title: Overview
sources.publisher: Severance Hospital, Yonsei University Health System
sources.note: founded 1885 by H. N. Allen as the country's first western-style hospital; names JCI accreditation without a year; carries unit volumes — the first 20,000 robotic operations in the world by 2018, about 2,000 coronary artery operations and about 1,300 arrhythmia treatments a year

sources.title: Liv Hospital — international site
sources.note: the group's own counters read on 17 September 2026: 723+ doctors, 1M+ patients, 20+ locations. Names Liv Hospital Ulus, Vadistanbul, Ankara, Gaziantep, Bona Dea and Istinye University Bahçeşehir Liv. Lists JCI accreditation with no year, ISO certification, the Türkiye international health tourism authorisation, a Ministry of Culture and Tourism authorisation and a four-star Global Hospital Rating.

sources.title: Accreditations — Hospital CIMA San José
sources.note: read in the browser on 17 September 2026 after WebFetch failed on the site's certificate chain. States a sixth consecutive JCI Gold Seal against more than 1,200 standards, with no year for the first award, and ANCC Pathway to Excellence certification described as the only one held by a private hospital in Costa Rica or Central America. The page's payments section names the departments that process payment and prints no figure.
